metadata.description: GATE 1 (pre-publish, offline): asserts every intra-@adhd/* dependency range in the release set resolves against {registry-published versions} ∪ {versions this release will publish}. Wired into `pnpm release`/`release:dry`; blocks publish on failure. See tools/nx-plugins/build/lib/range-resolvability.js.

GATE 2 (post-publish, end-to-end): npm-installs every publishable entrypoint from the real registry in an ephemeral dir + bin smoke, in parallel. See tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/smoke-test/clean-room-smoke.mjs.

BUG-ADHD-EE8D24C8-REVERT-001: flags a commit/range whose diff is dominated by deletions of files that already existed at HEAD/base (the proven shape of a stale working tree — e.g. after `git update-ref` moved a branch without updating its tree — committed back over already-fixed files). `.githooks/pre-commit` Gate 0 and `.githooks/post-commit` call the underlying `.githooks/detect-mass-deletion.js` directly (must run pre-node_modules-guaranteed); this target exists so CI/a server-side check can run the IDENTICAL classifier via `nx run @adhd/source:mass-delete-guard --base=<ref> --head=<ref>`, closing the local-hook `--no-verify` blind spot.
